_comment: All values are placeholders (0). Movement modules no-op until you fill these in for your exact Minecraft.Windows.exe build. Copy this file next to cheat.dll (the build already does this, see cheat/CMakeLists.txt POST_BUILD if you add one). Values may be given as hex strings ("0x1A2B3C") or plain integers.
_clientInstanceRva: RVA (offset from module base) of a static pointer that leads to the local player.
_localPlayerChain: Byte offsets to add+dereference, in order, after the first dereference of clientInstanceRva, to reach the LocalPlayer/Actor object. Use as many entries as your version's class layout needs; trailing 0s are ignored.
_positionOffset: Byte offset within the resolved player object to a Vec3<float> world position.
_velocityOffset: Byte offset to a Vec3<float> velocity. Required by Flight, Speed, NoFall, Spider.
_onGroundOffset: Byte offset to a bool 'is on ground' flag. Required by NoFall.
_noClipFlagOffset: Byte offset to a bool/flag controlling collision. Required by NoClip.
